biotools.summary: Copulacci is a Python-based model for inferring cell-cell interactions from spatial transcriptomics data, utilizing a Gaussian copula to model dependencies even with low transcript counts. It improves upon existing methods and discovers biologically meaningful ligand-receptor interactions.
